description: This file defines the SalesOrder class for the vtiger CRM system, representing sales order entities including properties, related activities, invoices, status history, and database interactions.

classes.name: SalesOrder
classes.description: Represents a sales order entity in vtiger CRM with methods for retrieving related activities, invoices, status history, and managing relationships.

methods.name: SalesOrder
methods.description: Constructor initializing logger, database connection, and column fields.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Saves the sales order module data, updates related quote status, saves inventory products, and updates currency info.

methods.name: get_activities
methods.description: Fetches activities related to this sales order, such as tasks.

methods.name: get_history
methods.description: Retrieves completed and deferred activities for this sales order.

methods.name: get_invoices
methods.description: Fetches invoices associated with this sales order.

methods.name: get_sostatushistory
methods.description: Returns status change history of the sales order, including headers and entries.

methods.name: generateReportsSecQuery
methods.description: Generates secondary query part for reports involving sales orders.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Returns relation tables based on related modules.

methods.name: unlinkRelationship
methods.description: Removes the relationship between this sales order and another entity.

methods.name: getJoinClause
methods.description: Overrides getJoinClause method to handle specific table joins.
